titleAnalysis.reasoning: Channel/Partner/Sales titles in Telecom are fairly common but vary by company size and whether the firm follows FMCG-style sales hierarchy or telecom-specific distribution structures. Title inflation exists (e.g., Territory Manager vs Channel Sales Manager), but the core idea is consistent.

titles: Regional Channel Manager (for slightly senior manager roles)

titleAnalysis.recommendation: Use both job titles and keyword-based filters. Core title is moderately standardized in Telecom, but variations like Territory/Area/Distribution titles are common and should be included.
